name: Catholic Men Organisation (CMO)
motto: Christ is Our Strength / Unity and Faith
shortDescription: Uniting all Catholic men and fathers in spiritual growth, family leadership, fellowship, and active service to the Church and Ugbolu community.
description: The Catholic Men Organisation (CMO) of SS Peter and Paul, Ugbolu, brings together all married and adult men in the parish. CMO fosters authentic Catholic fatherhood, assists in church development projects, mentors young men, supports parish liturgical programs, and advocates for peaceful community development in Ugbolu and across the Catholic Diocese of Issele-Uku.
meetingSchedule: Second Sunday of every month, immediately following the 8:30 AM High Mass.
keyActivities: Annual Father's Day celebrations and spiritual retreats
Sponsorship of major parish infrastructure projects
Welfare visits and fraternal support for elderly and bereaved members
Mentorship programs for young men and parish altar servers
howToJoin: All baptized Catholic adult men residing within Ugbolu and its environs are eligible. Register with the CMO secretariat after Sunday Mass.

name: Catholic Women Organisation (CWO)
motto: Through Mary to Jesus / Light of the Family
shortDescription: Fostering spiritual devotion, Christian homemaking, charity, and active lay apostolate among Catholic mothers and women.
description: The Catholic Women Organisation (CWO) is the vibrant heartbeat of maternal devotion, family spirituality, and parish charity. Rooted in Marian spirituality, the CWO supports the upkeep of the sanctuary, visits the sick and widows, organizes marriage enrichment seminars, and actively champions the annual Mother's Day and August Return initiatives.
meetingSchedule: Third Sunday of every month, immediately following the 8:30 AM High Mass.
keyActivities: Annual Catholic Mother's Day celebration and award of exemplary mothers
Hospital visits and distribution of food baskets to widows and orphans
Sanctuary cleaning and provision of liturgical vestments and altar linens
Skills acquisition workshops and health talks for young mothers
howToJoin: Open to all Catholic women, wives, and mothers. Enrolment is facilitated during monthly general meetings.

name: Catholic Youth Organisation of Nigeria (CYON)
motto: For God and Youth / Through Christ Our Lord
patronSaint: Saint John Bosco & Saint Charles Lwanga
shortDescription: Mobilizing Catholic youths for vibrant spiritual development, leadership training, community outreach, and joyous Christian fellowship.
description: The CYON at SS Peter and Paul, Ugbolu, provides an uplifting environment where young Catholics aged 18 to 35 channel their energy, creativity, and talents into the service of God and society. Through Bible studies, sports tournaments, vocational masterclasses, choral dramas, and diocesan youth rallies, our youths grow into responsible Christian leaders.
keyActivities: Weekly youth fellowships, Bible discussions, and praise & worship
Annual Parish Youth Week, sports festivals, and talent expos
Career mentoring, digital skills training, and entrepreneurship talks
Active participation in Asaba Deanery and Diocesan youth conventions
howToJoin: Every unmarried young person in the parish who has received First Holy Communion is warmly invited to attend weekly Saturday meetings.

name: St. Cecilia Liturgical Music Ministry (Parish Choir)
motto: He Who Sings Well Prays Twice (St. Augustine)
shortDescription: Leading the congregation in reverent liturgical praise, Gregorian chant, sacred polyphony, and contemporary Catholic hymns.
description: The Parish Choir elevates the worship of God through the beauty of sacred music during Sunday Masses, solemnities, weddings, and funeral liturgies. With a rich repertoire spanning Latin chants, English choral anthems, and inspiring traditional Nigerian hymns (Igbo, Delta-Igbo, and other indigenous languages), the choir fosters deep spiritual recollection.
meetingSchedule: Tuesdays & Thursdays, 6:30 PM - 8:30 PM (Rehearsals); Saturdays 5:00 PM.
keyActivities: Ministration at all Sunday High Masses and solemn feasts
Annual Festival of Nine Lessons and Carols at Christmas
Liturgical music workshops and vocal training for choristers
Feast of St. Cecilia choral concert and anniversary celebration
howToJoin: Auditions are open to parishioners with a passion for singing and willingness to commit to scheduled rehearsals.

name: Altar Servers Association (St. Tarcisius)
shortDescription: Assisting the Sacred Ministers at the altar during Holy Mass, Benediction, and liturgical processions with devotion and precision.
description: The Altar Servers of SS Peter and Paul are boys and girls trained in the sacred rituals of the Catholic Mass. Serving at the altar instills deep reverence for the Holy Eucharist, personal discipline, team spirit, and often nurtures vocations to the Catholic priesthood and religious life.
keyActivities: Serving daily morning and Sunday Masses, funerals, and weddings
Annual vestition and investiture ceremony for new servers
Spiritual retreats and pilgrimage to the Diocesan Cathedral in Issele-Uku
Annual Feast of St. Tarcisius celebration
howToJoin: Open to baptized Catholic children who have received First Holy Communion and demonstrate reverence and good conduct.

name: Legion of Mary (Praesidium Queen of Apostles)
motto: Who is She that Cometh Forth as the Morning Rising?
shortDescription: Engaged in Marian spirituality, spiritual warfare through the Rosary, door-to-door evangelization, and visitation of the sick.
description: The Legion of Mary is a world-wide association of Catholics who, under the banner of Mary, sanctify themselves through prayer and active apostolic work. Members visit the homebound, counsel fallen-away Catholics, teach catechism, and spread devotion to the Most Holy Rosary in Ugbolu community.
meetingSchedule: Wednesdays at 5:00 PM (Senior Praesidium); Saturdays at 3:00 PM (Junior Praesidium).
keyActivities: Weekly home visitation and bedside ministry to sick parishioners
Annual Acies ceremony of consecration to Our Lady
Recitation of the Holy Rosary before weekday and Sunday Masses
Distribution of Catholic miraculous medals and rosaries to inquirers
howToJoin: Attend any Wednesday meeting to begin probation as an active or auxiliary (praying) member.

name: Catholic Biblical Apostolate & Lectors Ministry
motto: Thy Word is a Lamp Unto My Feet (Psalm 119:105)
shortDescription: Proclaiming the Sacred Word of God with reverence, clarity, and liturgical dignity during Holy Mass.
description: Lectors and Commentators are consecrated to the proclamation of the Sacred Scriptures during the Liturgy of the Word. Through rigorous training in voice projection, pronunciation, liturgical etiquette, and biblical meditation, they break open the Word of God for the assembly.
keyActivities: Proclamation of First and Second Readings and General Intercessions
Liturgical commentary and guidance during solemn pontifical celebrations
Bible study sessions and workshops on effective public reading
Annual Bible Week and St. Jerome Feast day colloquium
howToJoin: Baptized, confirmed Catholics with clear voice diction and love for the Scriptures may audition with the lectors executive.

name: Society of Saint Vincent de Paul (SSVP)
motto: No Work of Charity is Foreign to the Society
patronSaint: Saint Vincent de Paul & Blessed Frédéric Ozanam
shortDescription: Person-to-person charity, welfare assistance, and corporal works of mercy for the needy and suffering in Ugbolu.
description: The SSVP is an international lay Catholic organization dedicated to tackling poverty and social disadvantage. In Ugbolu, the conference identifies destitute families, provides monthly food rations, assists with basic medical bills and school fees, and restores human dignity in the spirit of Christ.
keyActivities: Weekly adoption and visitation of indigent households in Ugbolu
Monthly collection of food items and secret charity distribution
Prison visitation and medical welfare assistance
Feast of St. Vincent de Paul charity banquet with the underprivileged
howToJoin: Anyone with a heart for charitable work and compassionate service to the poor is welcome.

name: Parish Pastoral Council (PPC)
shortDescription: The supreme advisory consultative body collaborating with the Parish Priest to shepherd and govern the parish community.
description: Comprising representatives from all approved parish pious societies, ethnic apostolates, youth bodies, and quarter wards in Ugbolu, the PPC assists the Parish Priest in pastoral planning, policy formulation, parish development, and promoting peace and communion.
meetingSchedule: First Sunday of every bi-monthly cycle at 2:00 PM.
keyActivities: Pastoral planning and coordination of liturgical and parish events
Supervision of parish infrastructure, security, and financial stewardship
Conflict resolution and community liaison with Ugbolu traditional council
Reporting to the Issele-Uku Diocesan Pastoral Council
howToJoin: Membership is by statutory appointment and election through recognized parish pious societies and quarter wards.
